summary: Full backend + frontend E2E test of the Byrd & CO email-only 2FA enhancement and cross-role (admin/client/lender) 2FA exposure. Backend: 54/54 pytest assertions pass across new /app/backend/tests/test_two_factor_email.py (12 tests) plus the iteration-12 regression suites (test_two_factor.py, test_2fa_final_state.py). Covered: TOTP enrollment regression (method='totp', status, sanitize_user.two_fa_method, login primary_method/totp_available, disable), email enrollment (setup send + masked email + purpose='setup' doc, bad-code 400, happy path via DB-seeded code hash -> method='email', no totp_secret, replay of used code rejected), send-verification (purpose='verify', requires totp_enabled, auth required), regenerate-backup-codes with email verify code (old codes invalidated), disable with backup code (valid=200 / invalid=400 / wrong password=401), email-only login shape (primary_method='email', totp_available=false, email_available=true), purpose isolation both directions ('verify' code rejected for login challenge, 'login' code rejected for disable), client+lender role enrollment + re-enroll guard (400), admin 2FA reset clearing two_fa_method (+403 for non-admin, 404 for unknown uid). Frontend: admin /admin/security method chooser (both cards, TOTP QR+32-char secret, email card with masked email/resend/bad-code error), Backups panel admin-only, client + lender header 'Enable 2FA' pill + help modal + 'Set it up now' navigation to /portal/security and /lender/portal/security with SecuritySettings rendered and NO Backups panel, and PortalLogin email-primary auto-send ('We sent a 6-digit code to t***@byrd-co.com', two-fa-use-totp absent, backup-code fallback authenticates). Final state verified: Wayne, Caleb, sample@example.com, contact@testfrost.example all have totp_enabled=false/two_fa_method=null and log in with a full JWT; temp seeded user deleted.

minor.issue: Email delivery failure is invisible to the user. Postmark returned 406 'inactive recipient' for sample@example.com during this run (backend.err.log), yet the API still returned {ok:true, sent_to_masked} and the UI said 'We sent a 6-digit code'. Because send_email runs in a BackgroundTask there is no way for a client/lender whose address is suppressed to ever complete email-only enrollment or email login. Recommend a pre-send deliverability/suppression check or surfacing the send result (and a support hint) to the user.

No rate limit / cooldown: each call inserts another code doc and triggers another Postmark send. Same gap flagged for /send-email-code in iteration 12 — still unrated. Suggest 60s cooldown + max sends per window.
No TTL index on expires_at and old/used docs are never purged, so the collection grows unbounded. login_attempts has a TTL index; this one does not.

Failed email-code attempts are counted by _record_2fa_attempt, but a wrong email code does NOT invalidate the outstanding code, so an attacker gets TWO_FA_MAX_ATTEMPTS tries against the same 6-digit code (1e6 space, low risk). Also each new send leaves prior unexpired codes valid (only the newest is checked, older ones simply linger).

ui_bugs.issue: Help modal is rendered 248px above the viewport top on the client portal — the title 'What is Two-Factor Authentication?', the intro paragraph and the 'Why it matters' text are cut off and unreadable (measured boundingBox y = -247.9 at 1920x1080). ROOT CAUSE: the modal is a child of ClientPortal's <header className='... bg-white/80 backdrop-blur sticky top-0 z-30'> (ClientPortal.jsx:89); backdrop-filter creates a containing block, so 'fixed inset-0' resolves against the 64px-tall header instead of the viewport and items-center centers the 560px modal on the header. Lender portal header has no backdrop-blur, so it renders correctly there. FIX: render the overlay with ReactDOM.createPortal(..., document.body) inside TwoFAHeaderLink (also protects PortalSecurityPage.jsx:17, which has the same backdrop-blur header).

Iteration-12 issue NOT fixed: 'Email me a code instead' and '← Start over' still collide on one line. The className is 'inline-flex ... block' (PortalLogin.jsx:217) — Tailwind emits .inline-flex after .block, so inline-flex wins and the parent space-y gap never applies. Remove 'inline-flex' (use 'flex' + w-fit) or wrap each link in its own div.

issues: Header shows the user's first name 'Sam' for contact@testfrost.example while the lender portal header shows 'Test Frost Bank' — inconsistent identity label between the portal and its security page.
Cards render well; only nit is that the 'Email Code' card has no 'less secure' visual weight beyond body copy while 'Authenticator App' has a RECOMMENDED pill — acceptable, no action required.

action_items: HIGH: Portal the TwoFAHeaderLink help modal into document.body (createPortal) — backdrop-blur header breaks position:fixed on the client portal, clipping the modal heading.
MEDIUM: Fix two-fa-use-email display class in PortalLogin.jsx (drop 'inline-flex') so the 'Trouble?' links stack.

MEDIUM: Handle/surface email send failures (Postmark 406 inactive recipient) for the email-only 2FA flows — today the user is told a code was sent when it was not, and they can never finish enrollment.
LOW: Add a TTL index on two_fa_email_codes.expires_at and rate-limit the three email-code send endpoints.
LOW: Align the user label on PortalSecurityPage for lender accounts.
critical_code_review_comments: TwoFAHeaderLink: overlays must never be mounted inside a backdrop-filter/transform ancestor; use a portal.

_send_email_verification_code returns success before the background send executes — no delivery signal, no dedupe, no cooldown; consider awaiting the provider call or storing send status on the code doc.
server.py is ~10.4k lines; the 2FA block (lines ~1000-1332) is self-contained and should be split into backend/routers/two_factor.py.
CORSMiddleware (server.py:9102) uses allow_credentials=True with allow_origins defaulting to '*' — pre-existing, still unfixed; browsers reject credentialed wildcard requests.
JWT signing key is 22 bytes (InsecureKeyLengthWarning in backend logs) — raise to >=32 bytes for HS256.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all specified flows pass; 1 HIGH modal-clipping bug + 1 unfixed layout bug)

rca_of_the_issue: Client-portal help modal clipping: ClientPortal.jsx:89 header uses Tailwind 'backdrop-blur' (backdrop-filter), which per CSS spec establishes a containing block for position:fixed descendants. TwoFAHeaderLink renders its 'fixed inset-0 flex items-center' overlay as a header descendant, so the 560px modal is centered inside the 64px header, pushing its top 248px above the viewport. Reproduce: log in as sample@example.com, click [data-testid=two-fa-header-help], evaluate boundingBox of [data-testid=two-fa-help-modal] -> y = -247.9. Mitigation: createPortal the overlay to document.body.
